status: Frozen before candidate execution or result comparison.
scope: Automatic compact cropBounds only; no model, analyzer, assignment, source-copy, explicit rectangle or output changes.
rule: After ordinary ownership and ownership-alternative expansion, save initial top and bottom crop edges.
Consider ordinary unowned components only (staffIDs empty; isOwnershipAlternative not true).
Require component height <=2 target staff spaces and width <=8 target staff spaces; both positive. Require horizontal overlap with the retained source width.
Require the component to straddle either initial crop edge. Do not inspect newly expanded edges and do not recursively chain.
Require its center to be strictly nearer the target staff core than any non-target staff core, and its bounds not to intersect a non-target staff core.
Expand the corresponding edge to its complete component extent plus the existing respective top/bottom clearance. Never shrink any existing edge.
Keep the page clamp and existing warnings. No page-specific rule, vocabulary or threshold retuning after results.
expectedRisk: Proximity is imperfect ownership evidence; this is a bounded candidate requiring source review, not a general correctness guarantee. Single-pass completion may preserve only part of a wider annotation block; conservative source rectangles stay unchanged.
validation: Positive/negative model fixtures, existing planner/system-boundary/crop tests, matched complete K478 and Brahms source-bound inventories, exact source guards, all changed page crops and neighboring-core counts.
